INTERNAL ARCHITECTURE

CALIBRE J-902 SPECIFICATIONS

Designed from a clean sheet, the Calibre J-902 incorporates a fully exposed celestial tourbillon carriage operating without upper bridges for unobstructed visibility.

ULTRA-MACRO 4K HOROLOGY

THE 60-SECOND FLYING TOURBILLON

Hand-chamfered mirror-polished titanium carriage bridges, hand-blued screws, and synthetic ruby pivot jewels. Operating at 28,800 VPH (4Hz) to neutralize earth's gravitational pull on the hairspring.

0.28 g CARRIAGE MASS
TITANIUM GRADE 5 CAGE
POLI NOIR MIRROR FINISH

REGULATING MECHANISM

60-Second Flying Tourbillon

Suspended on ceramic ball bearings without an upper retaining bridge, neutralizing gravitational perturbations with hypnotic 360-degree orbital rotation.

FREQUENCY 28,800 VPH (4 HZ)

ENERGY AUTONOMY

Dual-Barrel Power Reserve

Twin series-coupled mainspring barrels deliver constant torque across 72 continuous hours, maintaining chronometric amplitude until the final hour.

AUTONOMY 72 CONSECUTIVE HOURS

SKELETONIZED CASEWORK

18K 5N Rose Gold Architecture

Monobloc chassis forged in 18k 5N rose gold with hollowed openworked flanks, providing structural rigidity while shaving 34% of redundant mass.

WATER RESISTANCE 30 METERS (3 ATM)
HAUTE HORLOGERIE FINISHING

THE ART OF HAND-FINISHING

Over 240 hours of manual decoration are invested in every individual timepiece. Each bridge is chamfered by master artisans using gentian wood pegs and diamond paste to attain optical mirror reflections.

01

Poli Noir (Black Polish)

Flat surfaces polished on zinc plates to achieve reflections that appear pure black or blinding white depending on the lighting angle.

02

Anglage Main (Hand Chamfering)

Flawless 45-degree hand-filed bevels along every perimeter and interior angle, reflecting light along the perimeter of each skeleton bridge.

03

Perlage (Circular Graining)

Overlapping circular pearling executed on mainplates and recessed coves to capture ambient luminescence beneath the gear train.

04

Satinage & Micro-Blasting

Micro-beaded matte textures paired against brushed satin surfaces for visual contrast against polished rose-gold bevels.
